allocations.rationale: Directly extracts exact numerators and denominators from Rots et al. (2023) supplemental data for digital and palpebral signs critical for distinguishing KDM6B from Kabuki and Coffin-Siris syndromes.
Provides comprehensive cohort-level numerators and denominators for core neurodevelopmental, craniofacial, and gastrointestinal phenotypes across the major published Stolerman and Rots cohorts.
